scope: Org-only selected updater/caller/hooks/final-HEAD-lock and graph checks; evidence-only fixture successor

steps.name: Setup git
steps.script:
git config user.name  "github-actions[bot]"
git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

steps.name: Install git hooks
steps.script:
nix develop -c bundle exec overcommit --install
nix develop -c bundle exec overcommit --sign

steps.name: Update flake inputs
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail

nix develop -c bash <<'EOF'
  set -euo pipefail


  nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs channel update --forward-only --commit --no-changelog nixos-stable
  nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs channel update --forward-only --commit os-staging
EOF

steps.name: Check and push updates
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail

nix develop -c bash <<'EOF'
  set -euo pipefail
  git show HEAD:flake.lock > "$RUNNER_TEMP/flake-update-final.lock"
  nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs check-update \
    --old-lock "$RUNNER_TEMP/flake-update-baseline.lock" \
    --new-lock "$RUNNER_TEMP/flake-update-final.lock"
EOF
